artworks.title: A Naples: Défilé des... gardes-du-corps...
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures on a march. The image depicts several figures marching in an organized line. In the foreground, one figure holds a stick and walks with an exaggerated stride, while others follow closely behind. The background shows a structure with a classical architectural style, partially obscured behind the figures. The scene conveys a sense of movement and a satirical tone, consistent with a caricature style, emphasizing exaggerated features and expressions.

artworks.title: M. Prudhomme Philantrope
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.description: The image shows two full-body figures standing side by side. On the left, a young person is depicted in a slightly hunched position, with arms raised. This person has short, unkempt hair and is wearing a simple, worn-out dress with bare feet. On the right, an adult figure stands upright with exaggerated features, such as large, wide-open eyes, a top-hat, and a scarf wrapped tightly around a thick neck. This person wears a long coat that partly covers the hands. A small, rounded dog on a leash sits next to the adult figure, looking towards the viewer. The background is plain.

artworks.title: L'Empereur du Maroc consultant... Desbarolles
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.description: The image shows two full-length figures standing side by side. The person on the left is bent forward at the waist with legs apart, reaching out with both hands toward the other figure. This person has a beard, a broad nose, and disheveled hair. They are wearing a loose garment that appears tattered and bare feet. The person on the right stands upright, with one hand resting on their hip under their cloak, the other hand extended to the first figure. This person wears a hat and a cloak that conceals most of their body, with only the lower legs and feet visible. The scene is sketched in a simple setting with no decorative elements in the background except for a plain ground line.

artworks.title: A Man with Weapons (Un Homme d'armes)
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing in a composed position. The person is facing forward with their head slightly turned to the left. They are resting one hand on a table or bench covered by a textured cloth and holding a sword pointed downward in the other hand. The person has facial hair, wears a hat with a feather, a tunic with puffed sleeves, tight-fitting pants, and shoes. In the background, there is light hatching suggesting texture. A vase is on the left side of the table. The scene is set in a simple indoor setting with stippled patterns creating space around the figure.

artworks.title: Arabs of Oran (Arabes d'Oran)
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image shows two figures seated on uneven ground. The person on the left is reclining, with one arm supporting them, while the other arm rests on their body. They wear a headpiece and draped clothing, with a gun and bag nearby. The second figure sits with legs pulled up to their chest, arms wrapped around their knees, and head resting on folded arms. In the background, there are small groves of trees, two figures on horseback, and a person walking.

artworks.title: Study of a Woman, Viewed from the Back (Étude de femme vue de dos)
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image depicts a reclining figure, shown from their upper torso to the lower legs, positioned on what appears to be a bed or lounge. The person is lying on their back, angled slightly away, with their head resting to the side. Their facial features are softly detailed, with eyes closed or gazing downwards, and the hair appears wavy and cascading over the pillow. There is no visible clothing on the person, and the setting suggests they are resting on a textured surface with lines indicating bedding or drapery around them. The background is filled with cross-hatched shading.

artworks.title: a) Noce de Village (Village Wedding); b) Noce de Village (Village Wedding)

artworks.medium:
a) etching printed in black on laid paper;
b) etching printed in black on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: overall (outer framing line): 31.1 x 23.4 cm (12 1/4 x 9 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing a group of figures under a tent. The scene includes people gathered under a canopy made of draped cloths and wood supports. Objects like pots and fabric, along with some greenery, are seen around the area. The drawing features detailed line work that conveys movement and activity among the figures.

artworks.title: Noce de Village (Village Wedding)
artworks.artist: Charles-Melchior Descourtis after Nicolas Antoine Taunay
artworks.medium: wash-manner engraving printed in ochre on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: overall (outer framing line): 31.1 x 23.4 cm (12 1/4 x 9 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a group scene with a tent and trees. There is a large tent with flowing fabric and figures beneath it, set against a backdrop of trees. In the foreground, there is a shape resembling a dog. The setting suggests an outdoor gathering or festive event. The drawing has a light sepia or monochrome quality, giving it a vintage or antiqued look. The details are somewhat blurred, lending the piece an ethereal or dream-like quality.

artworks.title: Noce de Village (Village Wedding)
artworks.artist: Charles-Melchior Descourtis after Nicolas Antoine Taunay
artworks.medium: etching and wash-manner engraving printed in red on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: overall (outer framing line): 31.1 x 23.4 cm (12 1/4 x 9 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a painting of an outdoor gathering scene with various characters and interactions. The artwork is monochromatic in a soft, sepia-like tone. A large canopy or tent structure is in the center, surrounded by figures and objects. Some figures are talking, others are playing instruments, and a dog interacts with two small figures in the foreground. The painting suggests a communal festival or market atmosphere, with a mix of animated and relaxed postures. It is in the style of Jean-Antoine Watteau.

artworks.title: Noce de Village (Village Wedding)
artworks.artist: Charles-Melchior Descourtis after Nicolas Antoine Taunay
artworks.medium: etching and wash-manner engraving printed in ochre and red on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: overall (outer framing line): 31.1 x 23.4 cm (12 1/4 x 9 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a scene from a slightly elevated angle. There is a central gathering of people under a large tent-like structure, with a woman in a light dress, children, and a dog nearby. In the background, more figures are among trees. The brushwork is soft, creating a blurred effect. The color palette consists of warm peach, orange, and soft yellow tones.

artworks.title: Noce de Village (Village Wedding)
artworks.artist: Charles-Melchior Descourtis after Nicolas Antoine Taunay
artworks.medium: etching and wash-manner engraving printed in blue on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: overall (outer framing line): 31.1 x 23.4 cm (12 1/4 x 9 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a painting of a gathering or fair scene depicted in monochrome blue. The image shows a crowded scene with numerous figures gathered under a series of draped tents. There are multiple figures grouped together, and the tents create a framework in the scene. The presence of trees and soft clouds indicates an outdoor setting.

artworks.title: Noce de Village (Village Wedding)
artworks.artist: Charles-Melchior Descourtis after Nicolas Antoine Taunay
artworks.medium: etching and wash-manner engraving printed in ochre, red, and blue on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: overall (outer framing line): 31.1 x 23.4 cm (12 1/4 x 9 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a painting of an outdoor gathering under a large tent. The scene depicts a bustling setting with various colors and forms. The tent covers people who are sitting and standing. There are elements such as a table and objects seen outside the tent. The background has trees under a clear sky with scattered clouds, and the foreground shows figures seated, standing, or walking. This is in the style of Jean-Baptiste Greuze.

artworks.title: Noce de Village (Village Wedding)
artworks.artist: Charles-Melchior Descourtis after Nicolas Antoine Taunay
artworks.medium: etching and wash-manner engraving printed in pink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: overall (outer framing line): 31.1 x 23.4 cm (12 1/4 x 9 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with faint figures and shapes. The image features minimal lines in soft red or pink outlining shapes and possible figures in a light background. The upper portion is mostly blank, while the lower portion shows sketch-like lines and forms that suggest a gathering or event, without clear details. The use of soft tones gives the drawing an ethereal and unfinished appearance.

artworks.title: Noce de Village (Village Wedding)
artworks.artist: Charles-Melchior Descourtis after Nicolas Antoine Taunay
artworks.medium: etching and wash-manner engraving printed in ochre, red, blue, and pink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: overall (outer framing line): 31.1 x 23.4 cm (12 1/4 x 9 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image captures a scene from an elevated point of view showing a gathering of people under a large tent. The background includes a canopy, a tree line, and people interacting inside and outside the tent. The painting has soft brushstrokes creating a dreamlike atmosphere. The color palette includes warm pinks, soft greens, and muted browns. In the foreground, a woman in a white dress holds flowers with two children and a dog. In the distance, groups of people sit together, with trees and soft clouds in the sky.

artworks.title: Noce de Village (Village Wedding)
artworks.artist: Charles-Melchior Descourtis after Nicolas Antoine Taunay
artworks.medium: etching and wash-manner engraving printed in black on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: overall (outer framing line): 31.1 x 23.4 cm (12 1/4 x 9 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: This image shows a group of people gathered under a makeshift tent in a natural setting. The scene depicts individuals of different ages engaging in conversation and interaction under the tent. Surrounding the tent are various objects like jugs, bundles of sticks, and a dog. The background features foliage and a partially cloudy sky, creating an open-air ambiance.

artworks.title: Noce de Village (Village Wedding)
artworks.artist: Charles-Melchior Descourtis after Nicolas Antoine Taunay
artworks.medium: etching and wash-manner engraving printed in ochre, red, blue, pink, and black on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a village scene under a large tent. The painting depicts numerous figures in a rustic outdoor setting. The central focus is a figure dressed in a white garment in the foreground, appearing to be in motion. Around the figures under the tent are others engaged in conversation and socializing. The scene is detailed with wooden furniture, musical instruments, pets, and traditional attire. The tent is made of draped fabric, with trees and a clouded sky in the background. The style is reminiscent of Jean-Honoré Fragonard, known for Rococo-style paintings filled with social interactions.

artworks.title: Le Menuet de la mariée (The Bride's Minuet)
artworks.medium: color etching and wash-manner engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
image (including framing line): 30.7 × 23.4 cm (12 1/16 × 9 3/16 in.)
sheet (trimmed within the platemark): 38.3 × 27 cm (15 1/16 × 10 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a painting of an outdoor festivity. The scene shows a wedding celebration with lively characters in period attire, dancing and socializing in front of a rustic structure with fabric banners. Musicians are playing as people of different ages engage in dance and merriment. Onlookers watch under a partly cloudy sky, creating a festive atmosphere. The style is reminiscent of Jean-Baptiste Greuze, who focused on detailed genre scenes capturing human emotion and social interactions.

artworks.title: Pleasures of Brittany (Joies de Bretagne)
artworks.medium: lithograph (zinc) on imitation Japan paper
artworks.description: The image shows two women from head to toe, viewed from the side, walking hand in hand. The woman on the left is slightly bent forward with her head turned towards the viewer. The woman on the right walks beside her, facing forward. Both women have elongated facial features and are wearing traditional head coverings that partially conceal their hair. They are dressed in dark dresses with white collars; the woman on the right has an apron with vertical stripes. In the background, there is a haystack or large mound on the left, and a small dog stands nearby in the far left corner. The background features a pastoral landscape with wavy hills, a distant church steeple, minimal visible vegetation, and a flat horizon.

artworks.title: Human Sorrow (Miseres humaines)
artworks.medium: lithograph (zinc) on imitation Japan paper
artworks.description: The image shows two main figures seated outdoors. The person on the left is a young male with short hair, while the female on the right has long hair and is looking downwards with her chin resting on her fists. The male figure wears a shirt and the female wears a long-sleeved top with a darker skirt. In the background, there is a thick tree with broad branches and abundant foliage. Above them, partially obscured behind the tree, another face is visible wearing a hat.

artworks.title: Locusts and Ants: A Memory of Martinique  (Les cigales et les fourmis: Souvenir de la Martinique)
artworks.medium: lithograph (zinc) on imitation Japan paper
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people standing and seated. The individuals have discernible features typical of a sketch or print, with simplistic facial details. They wear long dresses or garments and appear to be carrying baskets on their heads. The background includes a tree, mountains or hills, and a body of water. The scene is rendered in monochrome and includes the artist's name, Paul Gauguin, and the title "Les Cigales et la fourmie."

artworks.title: Dramas of the Sea, Brittany  (Les drames de la mer, Bretagne)
artworks.medium: lithograph (zinc) on imitation Japan paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a rural scene by the sea. The image depicts three figures in traditional clothing standing and sitting on what appears to be a rocky shoreline, surrounded by abstract representations of rocks and the sea. The sea can be seen in the background with swirling wave patterns. A cow's head is partially visible on the left side. The style is reminiscent of late 19th-century artwork, characterized by minimalistic and expressive use of lines and contrast.

artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper

artworks.title: Chateau de Chenonceau, 1re planche (The Chateau of Chenonceau, 1st plate)
artworks.artist: Charles Meryon after Jacques Androuet Ducerceau I
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a chateau-like building. The structure depicted is a grandiose mansion, characterized by its intricate architectural elements such as steep roofs, numerous chimneys, and turrets with decorative finials. The drawing showcases the mansion's symmetrical facade, adorned with large windows and ornate details above the main entrance. The building is elevated, supported by arched supports. The style of the drawing is detailed and technical.
